entities.summary: Hannibal, a notable figure in the history of Italy, associated with The Roman Republic (264 BCE–146 BCE). Preceded by Punic Wars and Mediterranean Dominance and Early Republic and Italian Expansion. Their legacy influenced Hannibal crosses the Alps and invades Italy and Julius Caesar crosses the Rubicon, igniting civil war (49 BC).
